migration.history_strategy: This migration is a single commit on top of the existing M88 main commit. The source repository Git objects could not be reused by the target GitHub API, so source commit history is not imported; the source repository, exact source commit and original README are retained as attribution.
migration.root_license: No root LICENSE, LICENCE, COPYING, or NOTICE file exists in the source tree. No license was invented during migration; maintainers should establish the intended license before broad redistribution.
migration.inventory_limits: The GitHub commit tree exposes tracked files only. It cannot reveal untracked, ignored, or workstation-only files; the complete tracked tree at the source commit is listed below. No tracked generated build outputs or signing secrets were transferred.
migration.secret_scan: A targeted scan found no private-key, GitHub, AWS, OpenAI, or Google credential patterns. Sensitive-looking matches were sample tokens in tests and an intentionally constructed fixture URL.
